summary: Read-only multi-indicator scan for one or more symbols. Computes trend (EMA20/50/200, MACD, ADX), momentum (RSI), and volatility (ATR ratio, Bollinger width) plus 0-100 composite score per symbol.
core_logic: Pull klines per symbol via the supplied adapter (or fixture).
Compute trend indicators: EMA(20/50/200), MACD line, ADX(14).
Compute momentum: RSI(14) — current value plus 'overbought / oversold / neutral' state.
Compute volatility: ATR(14) / close, Bollinger Band width.
recommended_next_step: Use the per-symbol verdict ranking to seed deeper analysis cases (structured-trade-plan, three-tier-strategy).
